connector.name: TaScan
connector.registryDescription: Universal task protocol - manage projects, tasks, workers, QR codes, and reports.
connector.summary: Hosted at tascan-live-event.netlify.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package tascan-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the snowbikemike account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TASCAN_API_KEY
env.description: Your TaScan API key (generate in Admin Portal > Team > API Keys)
